title: Make shell workflows keyboard operable
description: Apply the PRD 14 accessibility baseline to primary navigation, project actions, confirmations, and recovery with semantic names, logical focus movement, and visible focus.
acceptanceCriteria: All primary navigation and project actions operate using keyboard alone
Controls and landmarks expose semantic accessible names
Focus order follows the visual and task order without keyboard traps
Confirmation dialogs move focus inside, contain it while open, and restore it on close
Recovery and status messages are programmatically associated or announced
Visible focus is present on every interactive shell control

steps.details: Inspect shell landmarks, headings, navigation, lists, forms, buttons, and dialogs; replace non-semantic clickable elements and add names only where native text is insufficient.
Define initial, contained, cancel, confirm, and restored focus for dialogs and place recovery focus at an informative heading or first action.
Add a high-contrast `:focus-visible` treatment that is not clipped or removed by navigation, list, form, and dialog styles.
Use appropriately scoped status or alert semantics for create, rename, delete, storage failure, recovery, offline, and update messages without repeatedly announcing static content.
Drive navigation, create, rename, open, delete confirmation, and recovery using Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, and Escape as appropriate; assert focus and accessible names.

technicalNotes: Prefer native HTML behavior over custom ARIA widgets.
Do not defer baseline accessibility to PRD 27.
